gaps.label: tool calls
gaps.consequence: No per-call identity record is written, so a tool call cannot be attributed to the agent that made it.

gaps.label: delegation
gaps.consequence: No grant chain is written for a delegation hop, so a narrowed authority cannot be proven from the chain.

gaps.label: policy version
gaps.consequence: A governance decision names no policy version, so which rule produced it cannot be recovered later.

gaps.label: approvals
gaps.consequence: The approval gate is off by default, so a consequential action can proceed with no human sign-off.

gaps.label: sensitivity
gaps.consequence: Taint flows into a derived artifact but its sensitivity classification does not flow out with it.

gaps.label: permitted models
gaps.consequence: This installation keeps no record of which models it is permitted to use, so a policy question about last month cannot be answered.
